$comment: What to create in the Flagsmith dashboard for LiteSwitch. This is a checklist in JSON form to recreate BY HAND (Dashboard steps: README > Use LiteSwitch on your site). It is not a Flagsmith import file. Names must match exactly: the code looks them up by name.

environments.name: Production
environments.purpose: Real visitors. Its client-side key goes in your production site.

environments.name: Development
environments.purpose: Simulation and local testing. Its client-side key goes in previews and .env.local.

warehouse.where: Environment Settings > Warehouse, in EVERY environment
warehouse.why: Experiments can't be created until the environment has a warehouse.

flag.name: page_weight
flag.notes: Paste the values as JSON strings. Keep the flag's control value = full, so anyone outside the experiment gets the normal page. Add no segment overrides while an experiment runs.

traits_sent_by_the_code.save_data: true when Data Saver is on
traits_sent_by_the_code.rtt_ms: estimated round-trip time in ms, -1 if unknown

segment.name: slow_or_saver
segment.rules: net_type IN slow-2g,2g,3g  OR  save_data = true
segment.used_for: AFTER the experiment: a segment override that rolls the winning value out to slow visitors only.

experiment.notes: Rollout can be 100% because the code only ever evaluates the flag for slow visitors. Creating the experiment starts it immediately and locks the flag, so deploy the code and send a test event first.
